judged_text: isTeamAdminOrOwner combines the admin and owner role checks with &&, requiring the caller to hold both roles simultaneously, so a team admin who is not the team owner is denied despite the check's name and the feature's team path. Team admins get FORBIDDEN on team bookings they administer; the defect fails closed (no over-grant), but the team-authorization path of the feature is dead for admins and the misleading name invites an unreviewed flip to || later.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` between `isTeamAdmin(...)` and `isTeamOwner(...)`, which requires the user to be both admin and owner simultaneously. Given the variable name and subsequent auth gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`, a team admin who is not the owner (and not the organizer/attendee) will be incorrectly denied access to add guests for team bookings.
